review_note: Only contained market-specific weakness was disclosed; Group underlying margin improved 70bps, operating cash flow rose 29% with 93% conversion, and organic growth, earnings growth and a record order book supplied multiple strong quantified contrary indicators.

Pandemic disruption produced quantified sales and profit pressure, temporary site closures and prudent suspension of acquisitions and dividends; underlying margin declined 30bps, while free cash flow rose 38%, gearing fell to 1.1x and record orders plus second-half recovery supplied strong contrary evidence.

Efficiency, facility expansion and manufacturing rationalisation were growth-led rather than distress-led; underlying margin improved 60bps, free-cash-flow conversion reached 95%, gearing remained low and revenue, profit and target-market growth supplied multiple strong quantified contrary indicators.
